author: /root
target: Derive the observable quotient jointly removing arbitrary whole-cycle histories, independent uplink/downlink plasma columns and arbitrary constant receiver phases for the documented three coherent radio-link architecture. Determine actual carrier-ratio and finite-error obligations before using reserved raw data.

premises.units: Received phase in cycles, not instantaneous-frequency-normalized phase.
premises.instrument_ratios: k1=880/749, k2=3344/749, k3=14/15, primary source confirmation pending.
premises.variables: fX_i,fK_i>0 supplied at matched emission events. U_i,D_i arbitrary real and independent at each endpoint. b arbitrary real constant vector within a supplied segment. n_i independent integer vectors. e_i real, no default bound.
premises.physical_imports: Coherent frequency/phase transfer, cold-plasma leading law, shared retarded rays/clock maps and actual electronics/calibration remain conditions; derive rather than silently import additional restrictions.

success_witness: Complete exact integer-annihilator classification and a nontrivial count-derived character retaining a common-phase functional under stated carrier conditions, or a scoped obstruction with concrete alternative. Derive observable error amplification and compare against existing format consistency without promoting it to physical error.
discriminators: Exact rational vs irrational relative uplink frequency
Fixed vs varying relative chirp and arbitrary initial receiver phases
Exact phase weights vs real normalized weights
Finite known error set vs unsupported accuracy from storage resolution
exposure: No new raw observation opened. Existing day169/170 four-file archive is exposed development; metadata/literature are instrument context, not independent empirical test.
next_route_if_closed: Calibrated bounded integer history / real receiver reset map, or a candidate-consistent invariant using actual recorded common synthesis reference. No state or error selector will be counted as a derivation.
new_obligation: The previous real phase/plasma construction and integer quotient each work on their own domains. Their physical joint admissibility under independent chirps and finite precision has not been established; this is a synthesis/measurement test, not substitution of a new numeric example.
